decision.latency_first_quantized: Use a conditional policy. For a strict all-input/full-logit contract inside the FP8 numerical contract at max_num_seqs=1, exact-packed BF16 lm_head beats native vLLM FP8 by 1.094x TPOT. For bounded batch-1 greedy workloads, per-row INT8 full-vocabulary scan plus exact BF16 top-128 rerank reached 1.199x versus native vLLM FP8 and reproduced 6/6 natural cases plus 512/512 GSM8K token streams, but this is empirical rather than mathematical identity and shortlist-external logits are unavailable. If a workload-specific lossy quality gate is allowed, group-32 INT8 reaches 1.219x versus native vLLM FP8; only 493/512 GSM8K token streams matched. At max_num_seqs>1, use native vLLM FP8 because the custom small-batch paths did not compose with service execution.
decision.quality_first_quantized: Q8_0 llama.cpp is the leading discovery candidate; its 8-chunk corpus perplexity is within 0.16% of llama.cpp BF16.
decision.speculation: Reject current MTP-1 and natural-prompt n-gram speculation for this 0.8B batch-1 workload. Even replacing every screened M=2 projection by its best cold-cache schedule projects to only 0.985x at measured acceptance and still needs 0.618 ms of independent cycle saving to clear the 1.03x promotion gate.
decision.strict_bf16: Promote exact BF16 block base-plus-delta packing of lm_head as the bounded SM89 batch-1 frontier. It preserves every BF16 weight bit, stores the lm_head at 77.46% of dense bytes, and improves the accepted strict frontier by 1.048x E2E/1.051x TPOT with 6/6 token-exact natural cases under a 3-warmup x 10-trial gate. Extending the format to the backbone was rejected: a 1.205x zero-unpack-cost model became 0.845x in rotating-weight scalar GPU measurements, while a metadata-hoisted padded Tensor Core screen reached only 0.453x. At calibrated bandwidth, the current 1.427 GB active weight stream has a 5.733 ms service floor versus measured 6.657 ms TPOT, so even deleting all non-weight time would cap this strict scope near 1.161x. This is a bounded empirical frontier, not proof of a global theoretical optimum.
decision.relaxed_bf16: The historical lm_head plus segmented-GDN route remains only a limited-task-quality observation against its old stock control. It must not be multiplied into the current frontier: a new same-source test with exact-packed lm_head enabled throughout regressed to 0.980x TPOT and only 2/6 cross-mode token parity. There is currently no promoted composed relaxed frontier.
decision.vllm_quantized: Reject the broken third-party W4A16 checkpoint. Among vLLM online conversions, per-tensor and per-channel FP8 failed the 3% materiality gate, while per-block FP8 selected Marlin and became useful when composed with the residual exact-packed BF16 lm_head. This is a quality-relaxed frontier, not a strict or global optimum.

measurement_risk.required_next_gate: For a production claim, repeat randomized BF16/FP8 process order under a locked power mode, replace the additive 375.691 MiB lm_head cache and transient packing peak with chunked CPU/load-time ownership transfer, and add broader reasoning, code, instruction-following, and sampled-generation quality suites. Keep max_num_seqs=1 and multi-sequence policies separate. Do not reopen small-batch exact packing without graph-shape reachability plus a pointwise winning full service curve, and do not reopen exact backbone packing unless a new data path first beats rotating-weight cuBLAS on every material shape.
